name: Omni Bedford Springs Resort & Spa
positioning: Historic 2,200-acre resort in Pennsylvania's Allegheny Mountains, home to the first indoor swimming pool, a springs-inspired spa and one of the country's first golf courses
best_for: Spa lovers who want treatments inspired by natural springs
Golfers drawn to a historic course
Travelers who like history, with downtown Bedford on the doorstep

facts.text: The resort is located in the Allegheny Mountains of Pennsylvania.
The resort is in southern Pennsylvania's Cumberland Valley, about 90 minutes from Pittsburgh, two hours from Washington, D.C., and three hours from Philadelphia.
Downtown Bedford is on the resort's doorstep, with a variety of historic tours within walking distance.
Guest rooms and suites pair Pennsylvania heritage with modern amenities and expansive balconies.
Resort View Rooms are in the historic wing.
Deluxe rooms have large windows with views of the hillside.
The resort has indoor and outdoor pools, and the outdoor pool has cabanas.
The historic Old Course offers views and challenges for golfers of all levels.
Amenities include a tennis court, a fitness center, and biking leisure trails and outdoor activities.
The resort offers family-friendly resort activities.
Dining venues serve local produce and signature drinks alongside views of the resort.

highlights.text: The resort is home to the first indoor swimming pool.
Spa treatments are inspired by the natural healing of springs first used by Native Americans.
Springs Eternal Spa covers 30,000 square feet, with the Bedford Baths and a spa lounge.
The resort has one of the country's first golf courses.

considerations.text: Guests must be 21 years of age to book a room.
The resort is a drive from the big cities: about 90 minutes from Pittsburgh, two hours from Washington, D.C., and three hours from Philadelphia.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires driving to nearby attractions.
